page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.xlarge is a memory-optimized instance equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs, 2 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, and 32.0 GB of RAM. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor using the x86_64 architecture and includes 35 MB of L3 cache alongside support for AVX-512 instructions. It contains no bundled local storage and has no integrated GPU accelerator. Network baseline bandwidth is specified at 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the processing and memory bandwidth in lower relative performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance benchmarks, such as stress-ng and Geekbench tests, fall into the bottom 25th percentile. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 20.9 GB/sec, placing it in the bottom 10%, while large-block write bandwidth measures 18.67 GB/sec. Application benchmarks record Redis SET throughput at 2.85 million operations per second and static web serving throughput at 3.36 GB/sec.

The instance provides high RAM density relative to its core count, delivering favorable resource allocation for applications requiring substantial memory capacity without heavy compute demands. However, trade-offs include reduced overall computational performance and lower memory bandwidth capabilities compared to higher-tier architectures. The overall hardware profile is suitable for memory-intensive applications such as key-value caching layers, in-memory databases, and web application backends.
